name: Ukesh Aryal
shortBio:
I’m an electronics engineer who likes building things that sit somewhere between hardware and software. I work across electronics, embedded systems, firmware, and the software around them — from circuit and PCB design to device interfaces, automation, and deployment.

I enjoy taking ideas from a rough concept or schematic to a working system, figuring out the hardware, firmware, communication, and infrastructure along the way.

Outside of work, I spend a lot of time in my home lab building, experimenting, and figuring out how things work.
